pages.text: The Ad Astra planets and their orbits are $(bold)Tier 4$() dimensions. Reaching the Tier 4 stage lets you in; you do not need to kill the dragon first.$(br2)To launch you need a $(bold)Rocket Workbench$(), a $(bold)rocket$() and $(bold)fuel$(). None of them is cheap, and all three need Tier 4 infrastructure already in place.

$(bold)Rocket Workbench$()$(br)You build every rocket at this station. Only a Tier 4 player can craft it, from Netherite, Mekanism Steel Casings and Steel Blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Fuel Refining$()$(br)Ad Astra fuel is refined with RF, and the refining takes $(italic)significant$() power: a coal generator will not cut it. Bring your Mekanism Fusion Reactor or Thermal Dynamos.

$(bold)Oxygen$()$(br)Space has no oxygen. Fill your space suit at an $(bold)Oxygen Loader$() before launch, and carry oxygen tanks for longer stays (a full MekaSuit needs none). The Oxygen Loader needs a steady supply of RF.$(br2)$(bold)RF Requirements$()$(br)Every Ad Astra machine draws much more RF than it does by default. This is deliberate: bringing proper power infrastructure to space is part of the challenge.

$(bold)Water-to-Fuel Processing$()$(br)Carry water to your planetary base in a $(bold)Dynamic Tank$() on your rocket, then run it through Mekanism machines:$(br2)1. $(bold)Electrolytic Separator$(): splits Water into Hydrogen and Oxygen$(br)2. $(bold)Rotary Condensentrator$(): turns Hydrogen into Rocket Fuel$(br2)Your Mekanism setup pays off in space, and the spare oxygen feeds your base's life support.

$(bold)Planetary Enchantments$()$(br)Chests on each planet hold enchanted books of its own enchantment, which protects against that planet's hazards:$(br)• $(bold)Moon$(): Lunar Stride$(br)• $(bold)Mars$(): Thermal Regulation$(br)• $(bold)Mercury$(): Stellar Shield$(br)• $(bold)Venus$(): Pressure Shell$(br)• $(bold)Glacio$(): Void Adaptation$(br2)Collect them on the early planets to survive the later ones.
